import json
def f(g):
    import copy; g=[row[:] for row in g]; out=g
    rows=len(g); cols=len(g[0])
    # find shapes (color 5 components) and fill interiors with 2, plus draw a horizontal line of 2 above each shape spanning from the start column to its end column
    H=[]
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if g[r][c]==5:
                r2,c2=r,c
                while r2+1<rows and all(g[r2+1][cc]==0 or g[r2+1][cc]==5 for cc in range(c,c2+1)) and True:
                    pass
                # bounding box of this component
                rr,cc=r,c;Rr,Cc=r,c
                while rr+1<rows and g[rr+1][cc] in (5,): rr+=1
                while cc+1<cols and g[rr][cc+1] in (5,): cc+=1
                R=[rr,Rr]
                H.append((Rr-Cc-1, min(r,c), max(rr,cc)))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for gap,rs,rc in H:
        for k in range(gap):
            out[rs-k][max(0,min(rc,cols-1))] = 2
    return out

    H,W=len(G[p+'input']),len(G['input'][0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(G[p+'input']) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==5]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for c in cells:
        if c in seen: continue
        st=[c]; seen.add(c); comp=[]
        while st:
            i,j=st.pop(); comp.append((i,j))
            for di,dj in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                ni,nj=i+di,j+dj
                if (ni,nj) in cells and (ni,nj) not in seen:
                    seen.add((ni,nj)); st.append((ni,nj))
        comps.append(comp)
    for comp in comps:
        rs=[i for i,_ in comp]; js=[j for _,j in comp]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(js),max(js)
        # find row with 2s above/below in output
        out=G[p+'output']
        above=[i for i in range(r0-1,-1,-1) if any(x==2 for x in out[i])][:1]
        b=[i for i in range(r1+1,H) if any(x==2 for x in out[i])][:1]
        for rr in above+b:
            s2=[j for j,x in enumerate(out[rr]) if x==2][0]; e2=max(j for j,x in enumerate(out[rr]) if x==2)
            print('comp',r0,r1,c0,c1,'line r=',rr,'cols',s2,e2)

def boxes_of(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    rs=[(r,[c for c,v in enumerate(g[r]) if v==5]) for r in range(H) if any(v==5 for v in g[r])]
    B=[]; cur=[rs[0]]
    for (r,cs) in rs[1:]:
        if cs and (cs[0]<=cur[-1][1][2] or cs[-1]>=cur[-1][1][1]):
            cur.append((r,cs))
        else:
            B.append(cur); cur=[(r,cs)]
    B.append(cur)
    return [(min(x[0] for x in b),max(x[0] for x in b),min(x[1][0] for x in b),max(x[1][-1] for x in b)) for b in B]

def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; W=len(g[0]); H=len(g)
    Bs=boxes_of(g)
    for (r0,r1,c0,c1) in Bs:
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            for c in range(c0,c1+1):
                if g[r][c]==0: g[r][c]=2
        beamrow=r0-1
        # interior extremes per side
        left_ext=min(c for rr in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if g[rr][c]==0)
        right_ext=max(c for rr in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if g[rr][c]==0)
        freeL=c0      # gap from box to left wall? actually c0 - 0
        freeR=W-1-c1
        if freeL<=freeR: side='L'
        else: side='R'
        s=(c0 if side=='L' else c1)
        e=(right_ext if side=='L' else left_ext)
        # wait: L -> beam goes from wall towards interior extreme; R -> from other wall
        if side=='L':
            s=0
            e=e
        else:
            s=s
            e=W-1
        for c in range(s,e+1): g[beamrow][c]=2
    return g
